units: <cite ref="Shabbat 151b:9">Sabb. 151ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>ת׳ בן יומו</he> a child not quite a day old.

<cite ref="Sotah 47a:15">Sot. 47ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Sanhedrin 107b:15">Snh. 107ᵇ</cite> <he>יצר ת׳ ואשה תהא וכ׳</he> desire, child, and woman should be repelled with the left, and drawn near with the right hand.
<cite ref="Yoma 82a:3">Yoma 82ᵃ</cite> <he>בן שלש … בת׳</he> at thirteen we order full fast by Biblical law: this refers to a boy; a. fr.—Pl. <he>תִּינוֹקוֹת</he>, <he>תִּנּוֹ׳</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Yoma 8:4">Ib. VIII, 4</cite>, v. <cite ref="P00972"><he>עָנָה</he> II</cite>.
Sabb. 119ᵇ, a. fr. ת׳ של בית רבן school children; a. v. fr.—Fem. תִּינוֹקֶת, תִּנּ׳ girl.
<cite ref="Yoma 82a:3">Yoma 82ᵃ</cite> <he>בן שתים … בת׳</he> at twelve we order full fast …: this refers to a girl (v. supra).
